interpretationRules: Catalogue registration supports documented participation when exact identity is verified; it does not itself establish current harvesting.

Organization endpoints are not substitutes for portal/system endpoints on system-to-system edges. Shared domains, homepage URLs, operators or programme names do not alone establish identity.
Covered refers to proposed research-draft edges, not a production write or approval. Downstream metadata evidence is limited to the ODIS development search and the scope stated on each edge.

Duplicate classifications preserve the original rows; they are reconciliation findings, not catalogue deletions. The 65 rows are not asserted to represent 65 distinct organizations or successful feeds.
Unresolved rows are retained as an explicit future expansion list. No new canonical IDs are invented and no outside-batch resource is described as deeply researched.
